Hint 1: a brick room that's always underwater
Hint 3: a hole behind the "CAUTION" sign that warns about the ghosts
Description: At water level 3, go down the chute located at mid-height in the main room. Swim all the way down the first brick room to find the piece sitting at the bottom.

Hint 1: a brick room that's always underwater
Hint 3: a hole behind the caution sign that warns about the ghosts
Description: At water level 3, go down the chute located at mid-height in the main room. Swim all the way down the first brick room. The piece is at the beginning of the dash plate passage.

Hint 3: a container on the pulley in the upper area of the hall
Description: Main room, top level, back right. On the pulley near the ceiling, there's a wooden box; the piece is inside.

Hint 1: a place where the fourth person of the group is buried
Hint 2: a room behind the "CAUTION" sign that warns about the ghosts
Hint 3: how do you make a square out skulls that form a triangle?
Description: Ghost room (at water level 2 or 3, go down the chute right of the start). Turn left from the entrance to find three small skulls on the ground. Dig in the fourth corner of the incomplete square of skulls, as indicated by the 3rd hint.

Hint 1: a wooden box on the steel beam
Hint 3: a room behind the "CAUTION" sign that warns about the ghosts
Description:
Ghost room (at water level 2 or 3, go down the chute right of the start). There are steel beams near the ceiling of the room, with two wooden boxes on them. The piece is in the box you'll see if you turn 90 degrees left from the room entrance.
(You can tell it's this piece if the radar is yellow before entering the room.)

Hint 1: a wooden box on the steel beam
Hint 3: a room behind the "CAUTION" sign that warns about the ghosts
Description:
Ghost room (at water level 2 or 3, go down the chute right of the start). There are steel beams near the ceiling of the room, with two wooden boxes on them. The piece is in the box in the back-left corner of the room.
You might as well climb up the back wall to get to this piece, because the camera makes it difficult to navigate the steel beams.

Description: Ghost room (at water level 2 or 3, go down the chute right of the start). To the right of the ghost room entrance is a vertical line of skulls. Dig in the wall above the top skull.

Hint 1: at the bottom of the main pillar
Hint 3: center of the bottom of the "Water-Powered Lift" hall
Description: Main room, bottom. The piece is next to the central pillar, at the corner that's facing the path to the brick room.

Hint 1: at the bottom of the skull fence
Hint 3: near a steel box containing a floating platform at the bottom of the hall

Description: Not available yet

(This is a tricky hint because it's ambiguous, and doesn't pick up on the radar when you get near the ghost room chute.)

Hint 3: inside of the mine cart in the highest room
Description: Top room (from main room, use the pulley at water level 1). To the right of the level 3 switch, there is a flattened mine cart. The piece is in the metal barrel next to it.

Hint 3: a room behind the "CAUTION" sign that warns about the ghosts

Hint 3: try digging under the moving weight
Description: Ghost room (at water level 2 or 3, go down the chute right of the start). Dig in the ground at the corner behind the moving weight.

Hint 2: narrow path, enter from the bottom
Hint 3: press switch No.2 and jump on the floating platform. Try Spiral Upper!
Description:
Enter the narrow path from the main room's bottom level. Do as the 3rd hint says. This is one of the few pieces that requires water level 2, not 3 (barring out of bounds tricks).
For this bottom Dented ceiling piece, the radar is green only on the southwest half of the starting platform; and the radar is inactive at the mid-level entrtance to the narrow path.

Hint 2: narrow path, enter from the top
Hint 3: press switch No.2 and jump on the floating platform. Try Spiral Upper!
Description:
Enter the narrow path from the main room's middle level (follow the minecart track). Do as the 3rd hint says. This is one of the few pieces that requires water level 2, not 3 (barring out of bounds tricks).
For this top Dented ceiling piece, the radar is green anywhere on the starting platform.

Hint 3: under the floating platform at the back of the narrow path
Description: Enter the narrow path at water level 1 or 3 (3 preferred for speed), and get to the end. The piece is in the center of the passage below the triangle skull, just above where the platform would be at level 3.

Hint 1: entrance to the mine cart dumping area

Enter the narrow path at water level 1, and get to the end. The piece is moving up and down far below the triangle skull (below where the platform would be at level 3, and next to the triangle skull wall).
This is perhaps the only piece that requires water level 1, unless you go out of bounds (could be a good idea, since this piece involves a lot of slow swimming normally).

Enter the narrow path from the main room's bottom level. Defeat the spiked car.
You can either defeat it out of water at level 3, or defeat it with an underwater jump off the ground during damage invincibility.
(Note: SM's data has two separate pieces listed for this.)
